commitResults.messageBody:
The starter classes need consistent package organization and
encapsulation to follow the project coding standard.

Add the project package, make task state private, use a descriptive
constant name, and document the main entry point.

The project needs a consistent coding standard for future Java
changes.

Require the SE-EDU Java standard for all new and modified code.

commitResults.messageTitle: Mandate project standards in Claude guidance
commitResults.messageBody: Claude guidance should explicitly direct future work to the\nproject-specific Git and Java standards.

Document the requirement to review the UI test plan and invoke the project-local test-ui skill after code updates. Add the reusable runner and initial console UI test plan so sessions produce comparable transcripts and stop on the first failure.
Support todos, deadlines, and events while preserving date and time values as strings. Update list and confirmation output and record the console verification scenario.
Move todo, deadline, and event behavior into Task subclasses while keeping the task list polymorphic. Preserve the existing command output and timing text.
